metaDescription: Invite colleagues and manage your company team.

hero.title: Users
hero.subtitle: Invite teammates, assign roles, and manage access for your company.

toolbar.title: Company team
toolbar.searchHint: Matches part of the name or email address.

table.caption: Company users
table.name: Name
table.resendInviteHint: Sends a new link and invalidates the previous one.

empty.title: No users yet
empty.description: Invite a colleague to join your company workspace.
empty.searchDescription: Try another name or email, or clear the search.

errors.loadFailedHint: Check your connection and try again.

validation.passwordMin: Password must be at least 8 characters
validation.passwordMax: Password must be at most 100 characters

invite.title: Add user
invite.description: We create the account and email an invitation link. Delivery may take a moment.
invite.roleHint: Optional. Assign a custom role from your company.

edit.title: Edit user
edit.description: Profile details only. Email cannot be changed here.

role.title: Change role
role.description: They will be signed out on all devices so the new permissions apply.

reveal.title: Show invitation link?
reveal.description: A new link will be issued and any link already emailed will stop working. Copy it and share it securely — we will not display the full URL on screen.
reveal.doneDescription: Share it out of band. Accepting this link does not verify the user's email.

setPassword.title: Set password
setPassword.description: Sets a new password and ends every session for this person.

delete.title: Delete user permanently?
delete.description: This removes {{name}} and frees their email for reuse. This cannot be undone.

statusConfirm.activateDescription: {{name}} will be able to sign in again.
statusConfirm.deactivateDescription: {{name}} will be blocked from signing in. Active sessions may remain until tokens expire.

toast.inviteCreated: Invitation created — we've sent them a link
toast.inviteQuotaExceeded: Daily invitation limit reached (20 per 24 hours)
toast.resendSuccess: Invitation resent — previous links no longer work
toast.roleUpdated: Role updated — they will need to sign in again
toast.cannotGrantRole: You can't give someone access you don't have yourself
toast.cannotDeleteSelf: You cannot delete your own account
toast.ownerLocked: The company owner cannot be changed this way
toast.accountAlreadyActivated: This account already has a password
